column3: “If not I will make you” is an oath formula; NASB has “most assuredly.”
“By his fellow citizen he works without paying” is rendered “uses his neighbor’s services without pay.”
“Windows my” (Hebrew form) is rendered “its windows”; NASB supplies “bright red” for “vermilion.”
“Will shepherd” is rendered “will sweep away” (a wordplay on “shepherds”).
“Nested” and “dwell” follow the reading tradition; “groan” follows a slightly different reading. The meaning is uncertain.
